note: Rejudged 2026-10-23 by an independent auditor (not the author) after 010e649057, which makes the final writer (session_ownership.go adjOutWrite.allow) send a synthesized withdrawal only to a destination holding an adj-out record for the route. RFC 4271 Section 3.1 allows a withdrawal only for "the IP prefix that expresses the destination for a previously advertised route". RFC 7311 Section 3.4.3: "Any change due to (a) in any of these values MUST trigger a new AIGP computation for that route." The moved unit is TestRFC7311ExtendedNextHopCostRecovery (both tags): it now calls advertiseFirst with the received UPDATE before receipt, so the cost-withheld IPv4 route over a 16- or 32-octet IPv6 next hop is withdrawn from a destination that held it. Assertions unchanged: exactly one withheld UPDATE that is the exact legacy or MP withdrawal; after a Loc-RIB distance of 11 appears and readvertiseAIGP runs with no new source UPDATE, exactly a second UPDATE with no legacy NLRI or withdrawn field, MP_REACH carrying the negotiated IPv6 self hop and original NLRI, and AIGP exactly 111 with flags 0x80. For a destination that held the route, not recomputing on the distance change sends no second frame and forcing legacy framing fails the MP assertions. The other six carriers (TestAIGPDistanceChangeReselectsRetainedRoutes, TestAIGPReadvertisesFromReceivedGeneration, TestRFC7311RecursiveZeroCostRemainsAnnounced, TestAIGPRecursiveDistanceUsesReceivedMetrics, TestRFC7311RecursiveAIGPChangeReachesWire, TestRFC7311ReceivedRecursiveAIGPChangeReachesWire) are byte-identical and their 2026-10-12 judgement stands; (b) threshold behaviour is not claimed. Ran: the moved unit PASS on 2026-10-23. FINDING (2026-10-23 audit probe): the re-fixture removed the only never-advertised recovery case. A scratch probe outside the tree (newAIGPReplayFixture, destination AIGPLinkMetric 43, unknown or zero cost, receive and forward with no advertiseFirst, then metric 11 and readvertiseAIGP) run through go test -overlay with the HEAD 010e649057 session_write.go and session_ownership.go gets 0 recovery UPDATEs where 1 carrying AIGP 111 is owed, for both unknown and zero cost: the withheld route is never sent to a destination it was never advertised to, because the AIGP recovery record (noteAIGPWrite) was taken only from the withdrawal that the final writer now drops. Before 010e649057 the initially-withheld subcases of TestRFC7311UnknownCostWithdrawsUntilMetricRecovers and the unprimed TestRFC7311ExtendedNextHopCostRecovery drove exactly this path; with advertiseFirst they cannot fail on it. An uncommitted session_write.go change by another session (aigpCostWithheld, noteAIGPWrite from the unfiltered withdrawal) makes the probe pass on the working tree; it is not committed and not judged here. Restoring the never-advertised subcases (no frame on withhold, then exactly one announcement with AIGP 111) is an RFC-tagged test change that needs owner approval, so it is reported, not made. Verdict weak: "Any change due to (a) in any of these values MUST trigger a new AIGP computation for that route" binds every destination, and at HEAD a distance change after an unknown-cost withhold produces no advertisement to a destination that never held the route, while every tagged carrier stays green.
